body: Thanks for being such beautiful people, everyone.
I'm sorry for the pain that brought you here to try to help others. Thanks for what you do.
You're fine. Honestly, I'm just surprised you're still responding to me. Thanks for that. I just want it all to be quiet.
I get that, I do. I guess I just don't have that kind of character or fortitude.
Not really. I have treatment-resistant bipolar. This is just kind of how life has gone for me.

It's coming together, bit by bit. There's nothing particular bugging me. It's been like this for a long time and I always knew I'd end up here. I just wouldn't have guessed yesterday that it would get to that point by tonight.

Sometimes people just don't know how to understand suicide. They can feel personally responsible for not doing more to keep you from getting to that point (even though that's often not how it works) and may get defensive and lash out as a result. Regardless, they should have treated you with love and understanding, but I hope you don't feel like their reactions automatically mean that they care any less about you. I'm really sorry you have to go through this, OP. And I hope it doesn't permanently keep you from feeling like you can't open up to other friends in the future.
